==Influences and decay chains==
each plague should have a symmetrical form where one decays into a debuff, one decays into a buff, and the other decays into something mixed

Like in cultist simulator

Heart influence decays into vitality<ref name=":0">https://cultistsimulator.fandom.com/wiki/Influences</ref>

Moth influence decays into restlessness<ref name=":0" />

Lantern influence decays into fascination<ref name=":0" />

Alternatively make every one go positive and then ambivalent and then harmful
